newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up on buying pressure.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up on buying pressure.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed up amid buying by small investors anticipating rise in prices after the Moslem Eid al-Adha festival later this week, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index rose 21.57 points or 1.98 percent at 1,110.66 on a turnover of 35.7 million taka. Gainers led losers by 87 to 19. "The investors are taking advantage of low prices of scrips. The shares fell sharply in a recent bearish spell," said one broker. Besides, good corporate news such as Bata Shoe offering 120 percent boosted the market.
Apex Foods gained 118 taka to 1973, Beximco Pharma rose 7.33 to 125.67 and Bata Shoe up 13.53 to 150.86.
